payload.title: P05 — Build pinned catalog inventory and license manifest
payload.description:
## Dispatch packet P05
Read initiative videoml-dbc2b1 sections D04 before editing. Those are binding decisions, not suggestions.

## Repositories and edit scope
stdlib
Primary paths: catalog/manifest.json; catalog/schema.json; scripts/import-hyperframes-catalog.mjs. Read repository AGENTS before any edits. Do not edit unrelated product code.

## Procedure
1. Read prerequisites and existing implementation at the paths above.
2. Add failing behavioral fixtures for the listed acceptance cases.
3. Read pinned upstream registry and directory union plus shaders; produce exhaustive unique IDs and provenance. Validate names/counts against the pinned checkout; no network scrape or skipped orphan. Separate upstream assets from replacements.
4. Run scoped checks plus required repo quality gates. Save actual commands, exit status and artifacts in an issue comment.
5. Return the diff and evidence to the primary reviewer; do not close the issue yourself.

## Acceptance
inventory exhaustiveness test and license/NOTICE report; all later catalog packets map to entries.

## Dependencies
videoml-684f74 (P02)

## Stop conditions
Do not guess a missing credential/account identity, bypass a failed test, substitute mocked evidence for a real smoke run, expand product scope, or change contract defaults. Report a precise blocker and return to the primary reviewer. A passing build alone is insufficient for rendering behavior.
